prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-03-05, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-03-05):
| Return 3m            | +8.4% |
| Return 1m            | +10.8% |
| Return 1w            | -0.1% |
| Range position (63d) | 89% |
| 21d realized vol     | 28% |
| Last close           | 48.77 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has recently shown positive momentum with 1-month (+10.8%) and 3-month (+8.4%) gains, and volatility remains moderate (21d realized ~28%). While it sits near the upper end of its range (89% range position), the prevailing uptrend suggests continued upside over roughly the next 20 trading days, though a near-term pullback could occur if range resistance holds.

DECISION: BUY
